_readme: Official availability sources, added by hand, one school or one conference at a time.
build_sources.js merges this into sources.json; the ingestion job reads sources.json.
An entry is USED only when it carries a url, so a half-filled entry is inert and safe to commit.
Add a school: put its ESPN team id (the same id football/rosters/fbs_<season>_espn.json uses)
under "teams" with any of availability_url, athletics_url, football_news_url, depth_chart_url,
roster_url, or beat_sources[{name,url,source_type}] where source_type is TEAM_REPORTER or
REPUTABLE_MEDIA. Add a conference report once under "conferences" and every school in it inherits it.
extract: how to read the page. 'auto' reads a table or list of player/status pairs; omit it for auto.
Never add a forum, an aggregator, a fantasy site or anything AI-generated: availability.js refuses them.
